title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study metadata from primary studies for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: Tailored workflow for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling (MASEM) extraction from primary psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Pre-loaded with a vetted extraction template that produces, for every reported sample: (a) item-level standardised factor loadings, (b) inter-factor correlations, and (c) coded study + sample metadata (publication year, country, language, sample size, age, % female, clinical status, analysis & estimation method) suitable for downstream meta-analytic databases.
task_description: Extract TAS-20 (2003) factor-analytic data: item-level factor loadings (F1.1–F5.20), inter-factor correlations (R1.2–R4.5), and study/sample metadata (pubyear, country, continent, lang, pubtype, n, sex, age, clinical, res, nfac, cfa, met, rot) for every sample reported in the paper.
context: Papers report TAS-20 psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Standard three-factor structure: F1 = DIF, F2 = DDF, F3 = EOT. Output uses flat dotted keys (F1.1, R1.2) so the viewer auto-renders them as tables. Coded metadata fields use the fixed integer schemes specified in the prompt (e.g. cfa: 0=EFA, 1=CFA; rot: 1=orthogonal, 2=oblique).
